author: Seung Wook
problem: Read N handles listed in ranking order (1st place first) and K; print the handles of the top K participants in dictionary order, one per line.
bug_description: Reads all N handles and sorts them before taking K, instead of taking the top K by rank and then sorting.

comments.accurate: Prints the handles of the top K ranked participants in dictionary order
comments.wrong_behavior: Sorts every handle in dictionary order and prints the first K of them
comments.wrong_location: Input reading verified; check the output loop prints exactly K handles
